messages:
alex: Quick check — I'm about to land a tiny TF change that renames the secrets path for the svc-config overlay in staging. Can folks confirm the helm values we expect downstream?

mennah: pinging @jen @chao — will this break the k8s overlay values or should helm handle mapping?

jen: should be fine if you update the Helm values file we ship in `infra/overlays/staging/values.yaml`. I can do a quick pass after your PR.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/894 — it's mostly rename from `secrets/api` -> `secrets/svc-config`. I added a short migration note in the commit message.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: running `helm template` against overlay...

ops-bot: deploy-checker: diff shows k8s/secret mounts updated, no pod spec schema changes.

chao: Quick Q: are we also moving the KMS key path? If so, make sure `kms_key_arn` remains untouched in values. Otherwise rotation scripts will miss it.

alex: Not moving KMS; only secret store path. Leaving `kms_key_arn` as-is.

jen: I ran `helm template -f infra/overlays/staging/values.yaml` locally and grep'ed for `secrets/svc-config` — looks wired up to the deployment envFrom. One minor thing: CI job `staging-helm-lint` currently warns about a template helper name collision (unrelated), I'll push a tiny follow-up.

alex: Thanks. I'll add a note in the PR description about the staging migration and add a follow-up commit to bump the helm-lint fix if that's okay.

mennah: Two operational checks: 1) When promoting to prod overlay we must mirror the path or add a compatibility symlink in TF. 2) Update the runbook step that mentions `secrets/api` path. I'll open a doc PR after this merges.

chao: For safety, can we add a fallback in the kustomize overlay like an env var that reads both paths? Something like:

```yaml
env:
  - name: CONFIG_SECRET_PATH
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: "secrets-svc-config" # primary
  - name: LEGACY_CONFIG_PATH
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: "secrets-api" # fallback
```

chao: if `CONFIG_SECRET_PATH` missing, app should try legacy. Low-effort and reduces rollback blast radius.

jen: I don't want to change app logic in this change. But adding a templated fallback secret mount in the overlay is okay. We should gate it behind a feature flag though.

alex: OK — I'll add a conditional in the staging values: `use_legacy_secret: true` (only until prod switch). Will include instructions in the PR.

ops-bot: ci/status: infra-tests (unit) passed. helm-lint job failed (jen flagged).

alex: merging now, will follow up with helm-lint fix and runbook doc. Thanks for quick reviews :thumbsup:
